facts.statement: Logging in during the Birthday Bash granted a free Birthday Cake hat, available until the Bash ended.
facts.quote: Log in today to get your free Birthday Cake hat before the Bash is over!

article_summaries.title: Happy 3rd Birthday, Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announcing Free Realms' third-anniversary Birthday Bash, which ran through May 24, 2012. It describes a cake bake-off storyline in Sanctuary led by Queen Valerian, daily party-prep quests, and a monster called Cakenstein disrupting the celebration in Sacred Grove. It also lists a free Birthday Cake hat and four new pinata pets in the Marketplace.
